A '''recon line''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Captain of the Line/Legends|captain of the line]]. Recon lines comprised either two or four [[Starship/Legends|starships]], operating either individually, or in pairs. These ships were generally modified [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruisers]], trading in weapons for enhanced [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]] and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suites. Recon lines were mandated to find the enemy, recon their disposition without engaging, then return with the information. The number of recon lines increased during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] equipped more of their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] with [[hyperwave signal interceptor]]s. These were capable of detecting flux shifts which allowed the Imperial Navy to accurate predict a starship's destination after it made the jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
